scope: Frozen EXE entry-point import and argparse startup only; no live GUI/operation commands
stdout:
usage: SpitfirePythonControl.exe [-h] [--simulator | --udp]
                                 [--pump-mode {empower,external}]
                                 [--host HOST] [--remote-port REMOTE_PORT]
                                 [--local-port LOCAL_PORT]
                                 [--self-test-report SELF_TEST_REPORT]

Spitfire Python Control

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --simulator           force the safe in-process simulator
  --udp                 select the UDP hardware transport
  --pump-mode {empower,external}
                        select the pump configuration independently of
                        simulator/UDP
  --host HOST           override remote controller host
  --remote-port REMOTE_PORT
                        override remote UDP port
  --local-port LOCAL_PORT
                        override local UDP bind port
  --self-test-report SELF_TEST_REPORT
                        run isolated simulator GUI checks, save JSON and exit
